title: Preserve pending manifest array fields
summary: Fix pending-publish manifest property access so single-item array fields remain arrays in the bundled PowerShell host.
reason: A real parked pending-publish manifest with one BDPGS embedded SRT track is valid JSON, but the drain trust check rejects it because PowerShell function return enumeration collapses the single-item array into a scalar object.
behavior_before: Pending publish drain could reject valid manifests with one-item subtitle arrays, leaving old parked output in PendingServerPush and causing the autonomy health gate to block new launches.
behavior_after: Pending manifest access preserves array-valued fields through PowerShell helper returns so the existing trust check can drain valid parked outputs.
manual_validation: DrainPendingPushes retry recovered 1 file, succeeded 1, failed 0, remaining queued 0
Launch preflight after remediation returned can_request_start=true and blocked_count=0
POST /api/pipeline/start launched once-mode pipeline PID 27944; startup log reached source indexing and queue scan
Real pending manifest trust check for Avatar Fire and Ash parked item - passed after array preservation fix
rollback_plan: Revert the pending manifest property-access change, the focused pending-publish safety test addition, generated summaries for touched files, and this change packet. Runtime state changes made during diagnosis should remain as operator-reviewed state unless explicitly restored from the archived event log.
notes: High-risk pending-publish drain path. Validation must include the focused PowerShell pending-publish safety checks and a real pending drain retry for the blocked manifest when safe.
